name: Aileen's site agent
description: Public agent for aileena.xyz (Aileen Choo): Solana/MEV research, security tools such as Tamper Check and KeyShield, AI infra notes, writing and DJ sets. Public mode only.

skills.name: Ask Aileen's site agent
skills.description: Ask a question about Aileen's public work. Same guards as the website console. Answers may follow the language of the question.
examples: What is Tamper Check and how does it work?

skills.name: Look up a project
skills.description: Find a public project or tool by name or keyword and get its stack, summary and links.

limits.ask_aileen_agent: 5 per minute and 20 per day per caller
limits.lookup_project: 30 per minute and 300 per day per caller

policy: Public mode only. Owner, council and private notes are not reachable. No raw IPs are stored; callers are counted with a salted hash that rotates daily.
